frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Ils aiment la pizza, n'est-ce pas ?

feedback: Correct! 'Have' as main verb uses 'don't' in tags (usually).

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Tu as une voiture, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: You have a car, don't you?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Ils ne nous ont pas vus, si ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: They didn't see us, did they?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Il est en retard, n'est-ce pas ?
Nous jouons au foot, n'est-ce pas ?
Ils ont de l'argent, n'est-ce pas ?
Je n'ai pas dit ça, si ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: I didn't say that, did I?

feedback: Correct! 'Aren't I' is the standard tag for 'I am'.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Tout le monde est là, n'est-ce pas ?

feedback: Correct! Nothing is negative -> Positive tag.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Tu ferais mieux d'y aller, non ?
Il y a un problème, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: There is a problem, isn't there?
You used to live here, didn't you?

feedback: Correct! 'Am I' is correct for negative 'I am not'.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Je ne suis pas en retard, si ?

feedback: Correct! Imperative -> Will you (or won't you/can you).

frenchComparison.englishStructure: Let's have a break, shall we?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Quelque chose ne va pas, n'est-ce pas ?
Tu voudrais du café, n'est-ce pas ?
Elle parle à peine, n'est-ce pas ?

frenchComparison.englishStructure: There weren't any people, were there?
He used to smoke, didn't he?

feedback: Correct! Nobody -> They + Plural Verb + Positive Tag.

frenchComparison.englishStructure: Nobody has arrived yet, have they?

feedback: Correct! Have to (obligation) uses 'do' in tags.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Tu dois y aller, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: You have to go, don't you?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Peu de progrès ont été faits, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: Little progress has been made, has it?

feedback: Correct! Tag refers to the subordinate clause when main clause is 'I think'.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Je pense qu'il a raison, non ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: I think he's right, isn't he?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Ne t'avise pas de recommencer, d'accord ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: Don't dare do it again, will you?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Aucun d'eux ne s'est plaint, si ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: Neither of them complained, did they?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: On ne peut jamais être trop prudent, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: One can't be too careful, can one?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Tu n'as pas besoin d'attendre, si ?
Tout le monde connaît la vérité, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: Everybody knows the truth, don't they?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Il a dû partir, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: He had to leave, didn't he?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Peu de gens le savent, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: Few people know this, do they?

feedback: Correct! Tag refers to 'you know'. 'I don't suppose' makes the whole sentence negative -> Positive tag.

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Je ne suppose pas que tu saches, si ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: I don't suppose you know, do you?

feedback: Correct! Request -> Can you / Could you / Will you.

frenchComparison.englishStructure: Pass me the salt, can you?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: Aucun de nous n'y va, si ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: None of us are going, are we?

frenchComparison.frenchStructure: C'est la meilleure solution, n'est-ce pas ?
frenchComparison.englishStructure: This is the best solution, isn't it?
You dare not ask, dare you?
